newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 1.6 billion yuan from 950 million on Thursday with the 90-day contract the most active.

Traders said trading was more active today. Financial institutions borrowed more money through the short-term finance centres, the money brokerages run by the central bank, to cover shortages before the Chinese Lunar New Year in early February.

"Some financial institutions borrowed more funds from the centres, adding liquidity to the thin market," a trader said. "The 90-day contract became the most active because of their fund shortage before the Lunar New Year."
Traders expect the rates for the mid-term contracts to be firmer than others in the next few weeks due to the Lunar New Year shortfall. -- Shanghai newsroom (86-21) 6279-7004
